notes:
The independent reading began with the original leaf and both native overlapping halves, checked line by line against the consolidated draft and both original witnesses. The packet’s current mark decisions and remaining-doubt descriptions were consulted only after those three image inspections. The existing inventory was then checked against the page; two newly represented physical features are added beside their parent material, and the complete 34-element order is supplied. The top author’s 18 and lower-left lighter 100 remain as written.

Six substantive audit proposals are recorded. In the condition-3 display, the connector has a short raised crest and downward terminal rather than two completed arrowhead wings. Its literal contour is copied. The mathematical role does not supply a missing wing. M0486 is therefore other: the graphic is definite, while the author’s intended dash/arrow interpretation remains unresolved in the notation note. The unprimed x in both arguments of this display is retained, despite x-prime in the immediately preceding prose; this consistency tension is not corrected.

In condition 4, four underline strokes form two distinct pairs, separated by a gap. The short pair belongs to pas néc.; the longer pair belongs to un X-morphisme. The right endpoints stop before the exclamation mark. The auditor saw that relation in the native bottom half; the main reader subsequently created and viewed the single previously uncovered exclamation crop, which confirms it. That new crop is recorded as main-reader evidence only, not in the auditor’s personal-view list. The original C and current continuous uuline would fill the gap and extend the rules under the exclamation. H does not render the rules. The separate earlier H expansion of néc. is not counted again.

The first restriction bar, in I-prime_1 = X-prime_1 [bar] I, carries a genuine short rightward middle tick. The other restriction bars on this page are plain. The small tick was already mentioned descriptively in the shared notation but was absent from the TeX; it is now reproduced literally. It is not interpreted as a logical-entailment sign. The inserted prolongée has a curved under-running leader, turning down at its left into the space before de Theta. Its textual attachment was already correct; the physical stroke is restored. In the upper margin, the rule beneath sur I extends much farther than the words in both directions. The enlarged contour replaces the shorter word-width underline; the surrounding doubtful text remains unchanged.

The condition-2 insertion ends at pi. There is no detached period after that sign in the existing insertion crop, and the main reader independently confirmed the absence. The period shared by C and the consolidated draft is removed. H’s trailing ill is not interpreted as an assertion of a literal period; this finding is C-only. The acting pi itself, the d’un phrase and ss-groupes abbreviation remain the accepted readings.

The last noun in condition 4 resolves to ambiguïté. Its compact letter sequence includes a looped descending g, dotted i and terminal t/é movement, with no plural s before the comma. This is a certainty-only resolution of the current leading reading; it is recorded in M0494, not counted as a seventh substantive finding. The final field of the earlier D50 record should be synchronized with ambiguïté when the main reader merges the audit. All other source mark decisions remain unchanged.

The remaining doubtful material was reconsidered against the two margin crops, the first-hypothesis crop and the condition-3 action crop. The upper marginal numbered/f-like sign, exponent nu K, final adjective ending and two signs before connexe remain open. Cancellation still obscures the initial existential expression, des tels, généraliser and l’imposant. The lower marginal en/ne sequence, struck quantifier, possible pas and kernel wording retain in-place uncertainty. The crossed expression above the last groupoid map still does not securely distinguish its initial I-prime_1 from X-prime_1. The exact LaTeX in the remaining-doubt list has been synchronized with the page’s actual apostrophe primes; no new source reading is implied by that bookkeeping correction.

No new mathematical proof, computation or formal check was performed during this audit. The existing first-reading checks are not relabelled as audit events. In particular, the cramped lower-margin juxtaposition of f and the final fundamental-group expression has not been repaired to a mathematically expected map, and the unclear marginal power/signs have not been chosen from a conjectured interpretation.

Nine pre-existing evidence crops were personally opened once: the condition-3 display, main_D40_41, the condition-4 ending and corrections, both margins, the condition-2 insertion, the first hypothesis and the condition-3 action. No auditor crop was made. Main-reader messages confirm the five graphic refinements, the ambiguïté resolution, the absent terminal period and the exclamation’s position. The main reader’s exclamation image was not personally opened by this auditor. No OCR, outside research, compilation, other-page reading or changes to accepted/global records were undertaken.
